equipment:

Asset type: transparent raster sprite sheet for a 2D backyard sports game.
Primary request: Create ONE square sprite sheet containing exactly FOUR separate illustrated equipment objects in four generous non-overlapping 2x2 cells with ample transparent gutters. Top left: a substantial regulation-shaped wooden cornhole board; top right: a portable basketball hoop; bottom left: a freestanding football accuracy target panel; bottom right: an empty party pong table.
Input images: Image 1 is a STYLE reference only, for realistic illustrated thick ink lines, cutout edge and rendering detail. Image 2 is a STYLE and cornhole construction reference only. Do not include any people, lettering, logos, scenery or poster elements from the references.
Scene/backdrop: GENUINELY TRANSPARENT RGBA background with actual alpha=0 pixels, not a checkerboard, not white paper or any opaque solid backdrop. Each object is a cream-contoured paper cutout floating alone with no ground plane and no cast shadow outside its cutout.
Style/medium: Recognizable realistically constructed sports equipment drawn in vivid hand-inked graphic-novel style, thick dark black outlines, mustard golden yellow, orange and muted deep teal paint, warm plywood, weathered screenprint stippling and visible grain. Match the style of the provided illustrated Dan figure. Flat cutout game artwork, not vector geometric placeholders, not plastic 3D renders.
Composition: These objects will sit on the RIGHT of a scene and receive throws from a person standing on the LEFT. Use gentle three-quarter view toward the left, with clear large playing surfaces and little foreshortening. Objects must be complete within their own cells; do not overlap or crop them.
Top-left cornhole: sturdy long rectangle of warm plywood with thick visible plywood side and two raised rear legs. Its low FRONT end is at LOWER LEFT, its raised BACK end at UPPER RIGHT. The long playing surface runs diagonally lower-left to upper-right. Make the board broad and substantial with orange paint, mustard trim and simple dark teal stripe, no lettering. One large, true circular aperture near the far upper-right end with visible dark inner rim; no bags or balls on it. Entire four-sided playing surface clearly visible; moderate perspective not extreme.
Top-right basketball hoop: full portable hoop with weighted teal base, sturdy dark upright pole, large rectangular cream/teal backboard with simple black rectangle marking, orange metal rim jutting toward LEFT, and fully hanging white knotted net beneath. Show clear open elliptical rim interior. Recognizable real hoop construction. Leave all objects separate.
Bottom-left football target: substantial rectangular accuracy practice panel set upright on two strong supports with broad stable feet, cream and teal outer panel, three orange/mustard/cream concentric circles, black inner bullseye. Large bullseye toward upper-middle of panel; clearly readable circular target rings on the panel facing diagonally LEFT. No holes other than drawn target graphics, no numbers, words or decorative balls.
Bottom-right pong table: broad long rectangular tabletop on four sturdy dark folding legs. Low FRONT/near end LOWER LEFT and far end UPPER RIGHT, visible flat teal playing surface with mustard/cream edge, thick tabletop edge, modest orange details. Empty surface, NO cups, NO balls, NO net.
Constraints: Exactly 4 separate equipment sprites, no people, no background, no floor, no scenery, no text, no numbers, no watermarks, no cell dividers. Real alpha transparency is required. Preserve generous cream outline around each object, including its base.
